property_summary: After any call to fallback, pastBlockTime is either zero (never called) or the timestamp at some call where msg.value was exactly 10 ether; the bug allows a 0-ether call to update pastBlockTime, leaving it at a timestamp where no 10-ether call occurred.
change_summary: Change require value from 10 ether to 0 ether so fallback can be called with different msg.value.
